verdict.rationale: LegalZoom provides customizable legal documents, so e-signature workflow controls are a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence never mentions e-signature, signing order, or expiration settings on signature requests. The only reminders documented are compliance-calendar alerts for annual report deadlines, which are a different feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can set signing order, automatic reminders, and expirations on outstanding signature requests
